column1: # Claims of concepts-start-up-path.svg and the paragraphs around it in docs/concepts/start-up.md.
element
a distribution package installs vtium's programs and units
its install script gives vtium every free VT, with vtium console enable --direct --all
systemd starts vtium at boot on each VT it has
logind starts vtium when you switch to one of those VTs and no vtium runs there
logind starts a console on VTs 1 to 6 by itself
vtium reads vtium.conf
if vtium cannot use all of the file, it runs what it can and shows a notice
vtium opens its VT
vtium takes over the VT's switches
vtium tells systemd that it is ready, once its VT is open
systemd starts a display manager only after this
vtium opens the keyboards and pointers that udev reports
under the closed policy, vtium opens only those a rule names
vtium waits for its VT to be shown
vtium takes the display: it becomes the program that sets the display's mode
it waits for a display for up to display-wait
transition once a display is set up
vtium starts login in a pty
when login exits, vtium starts it again
vtium exits with status 1
no display appears in time
sessions end too fast, under the open policy
open policy: vtium-getty@ starts
open policy: a getty on the VT
closed policy: no getty starts
closed policy: systemd starts vtium again
